name: Catalog of GRPO training data variants prepared in R4 for sweep
purpose: Comprehensive data-shape catalog supporting Eric mandate: 'focus on data, not hyperparams.' All variants use the SAME training recipe (lr=1e-5, rank=16, alpha=32, kl=0.02, dr_grpo) so any signal comes from data shape.

iter1-grpo-train.jsonl.source: R3 iter-1 training rollouts from base

iter2-grpo-train.jsonl.source: R3 iter-2 training rollouts; 3x larger than iter-4

iter4-grpo-train.jsonl.source: R3 iter-4 training rollouts (the R3 winner data)

iter4-grpo-train-strong.jsonl.source: R3 elite filter (--filter-var-min 0.05) of iter-4 data

iter4-train-pow2.jsonl.rationale: Sharpen gradient between high and low rewards

iter4-train-binarized.jsonl.transform: reward ← 1.0 if argmax in group else 0.0

iter4-train-highvar.jsonl.transform: drop groups where reward range < median (median=0.118)
iter4-train-highvar.jsonl.rationale: Reduce training waste on degenerate groups

iter4-train-ranked.jsonl.rationale: Pure ordinal — strip absolute reward magnitudes, preserve only ordering

iter4-train-topbottom-pair.jsonl.rationale: Reduces GRPO to DPO-style preference learning with maximal contrast

merged-iter-1-4-11.jsonl.transform: concatenate iter-1 + iter-4 + iter-11 (different generations of model)
merged-iter-1-4-11.jsonl.rationale: Multi-source data — different parent generations give different prompt response distributions

top50-merged-1-4-11.jsonl.transform: merged 1/4/11 filtered to top-50% by group mean composite (threshold=0.688)

union-iter2-iter4.jsonl.rationale: Combined breadth (iter-2's 24 groups) + R3-winner data (iter-4's 8 groups)

deferred_arms_explanation: Pod lease ~5:36 expiry leaves room for ~3-4 more arms after current queue completes. Will dynamically pick winners (top H/I or J/K) based on B/D/F/G results once eval data is in.
